PROCEDURE DUP_DB_REC_CHK IS

counter NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 if :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type is not null or :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_code is not null 
 then
 begin
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS
 WHERE UPPER(CUSTOMER_ID) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:control_block.S_CUSTOMER_ID)))
 AND UPPER(nvl(CONSIGNEE_ID,'x')) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(nvl(:control_block.S_CONSIGNEE_ID,'x'))))
 AND (UPPER(prod_type) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type)))
 OR UPPER(prod_code) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_code)))); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 if UPPER(:system.record_status) in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then --, 'CHANGED') then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

PROCEDURE DUP_DB_SRC_CHK IS

counter NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 if :vserv_customer_products.product_type is not null or :vserv_customer_products.product_code is not null and
 :vserv_customer_products.eff_date is not null then
 begin
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS
 WHERE UPPER(CUSTOMER_ID) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:control_block.S_CUSTOMER_ID)))
 AND UPPER(nvl(CONSIGNEE_ID,'x')) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(nvl(:control_block.S_CONSIGNEE_ID,'x'))))
 AND (UPPER(prod_type) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:vserv_customer_products.product_type)))
 OR UPPER(prod_code) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:vserv_customer_products.product_code))))
 AND trunc(:vserv_customer_products.eff_date) <= trunc(nvl(term_date, :vserv_customer_products.eff_date + 1))
 AND trunc(nvl(:vserv_customer_products.term_date, eff_date + 1)) >= trunc(eff_date); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 if UPPER(:system.record_status) in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then --, 'CHANGED') then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC_CHK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*---
This procedure will be used to check the duplicate records --- 
The program will prevent enteries if the product type, product code, eff date are the same 
*/
PROCEDURE DUP_REC_CHK IS


counter number(10);
src_counter number(10);
rec_num number(10);
--variables to store values in
v_prod_type varchar2(5);
v_prod_code varchar2(8);
v_CUSTOMER_ID varchar2(10);
v_CONSIGNEE_ID varchar2(10);
v_eff_date date;
v_term_date date;

v_no_of_rec number(10);
curr_rec number(10);
BEGIN

go_block('VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS');
last_record;
v_no_of_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track # of records in the block for loop
first_record;--return to first rec
for i in 1 .. v_no_of_rec loop 
curr_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track which rec we left off at

 v_CUSTOMER_ID := :control_block.s_CUSTOMER_ID;
 v_CONSIGNEE_ID := :control_block.s_CONSIGNEE_ID;
 v_prod_type := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type;
 v_prod_code := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_code;
 v_eff_date := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.eff_date;
 v_term_date := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.term_date;
 

 first_record;--to compare thru the whole block for dups
 counter := 0;
 src_counter := 0;
 loop 
 if :control_block.s_CUSTOMER_ID = v_CUSTOMER_ID and
 nvl(:control_block.s_CONSIGNEE_ID,'x') = nvl(v_CONSIGNEE_ID,'x') and
 (:VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type = v_prod_type or --tmppp
 :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_code = v_prod_code) then

 counter := counter + 1;
 end if;
 
 /* if :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type = v_prod_type and
 trunc(:VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.eff_date) <= trunc(nvl(v_term_date, :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.eff_date + 1)) and
 trunc(nvl(:VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.term_date, v_eff_date + 1)) >= trunc(v_eff_date) then

 src_counter := src_counter + 1;
 end if; */ --tmppp
 exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 if counter > 1 then --or src_counter > 1 then --tmppp 
 BELL;
 go_record(curr_rec);
 show_error('0319'); 
 end if;

go_record(curr_rec+1); --back to the rec we left off at + 1- sort of next record 

end loop;

first_record;


end;

PROCEDURE NULL_PROD_CHK IS
/*---
This procedure will be used to check the null value for product info --- 
*/
counter number(10);
--variables to store values in
v_prod_type varchar2(5);
v_prod_code varchar2(8);
v_eff_date date;

v_no_of_rec number(10);
curr_rec number(10);
BEGIN

go_block('VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS');
last_record;
v_no_of_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track # of records in the block for loop
first_record;--return to first rec
for i in 1 .. v_no_of_rec loop 
curr_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track which rec we left off at

 v_prod_type := null;
 v_prod_code := null;
 v_eff_date := null;
 
 v_prod_type := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_type;
 v_prod_code := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.product_code;
 v_eff_date := :VSERV_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTS.eff_date;
 

 first_record;--to compare thru the whole block for dups
 counter := 0;
 loop 
 if v_prod_type is null and v_prod_code is not null
 and v_eff_date is not null then
 null;
 elsif v_prod_type is not null and v_prod_code is null
 and v_eff_date is not null then
 null; 
 else
 counter := counter + 1;
 end if;
 exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 if counter > 1 then 
 BELL;
 go_record(curr_rec);
 --show_error('0319'); 
 Message('Please check the missing values for "product type or product code or eff date" must be enter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

go_record(curr_rec+1); --back to the rec we left off at + 1- sort of next record 

end loop;

first_record;


end;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_PRODUCT_TYPE_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select PRODUCT_TYPE code,PRODUCT_TYPE_DESC code_desc from vserv_product_types 
where 
(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate) ) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate)+1))
order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_S_CONSIGNEE_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select consignee_id from consignee where customer_id = :control_block.s_customer_id and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and (Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate) ) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate)+1))

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CUSTOMER_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select c.customer_id,name from customers c where c.customer_type IN ('RG', 'EX', 'RD','DI','MG') and c.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and (Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate) ) between trunc(c.eff_date) and nvl(trunc(c.term_date),trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:control_block.chapter_id,sysdate)+1))
order by 1

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_gmt_time date;
begin

 if :vserv_customer_products.product_type is null and :vserv_customer_products.product_code is null then
 message('Either "Product Type" or "Product Code" must be enter'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 
 elsif :vserv_customer_products.eff_date is null then
 message('"Effective Date" must be enter'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 if :system.trigger_block not in ('CONTROL_BLOCK')
 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 :vserv_customer_products.customer_id:= :control_block.s_customer_id;
 :vserv_customer_products.consignee_id:= :control_block.s_consignee_id;
 --
 if (:system.record_status = 'CHANGED' and :global.src_value_changed = 'Y') or 
 (:system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT')) then
 DUP_DB_SRC_CHK;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 DUP_REC_CHK;
 check_package_failure;
 --- 
/* --No timezone code for Eff Date and Term Date. 
 if :vserv_customer_products.eff_date is not null then
 if is_timezone_enabled then --(v_timezone_mode) then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:vserv_customer_products.eff_date,v_gmt_time);
 Message('gmt time:effDBefore:Commit: '||v_gmt_time); pause; --tmppp
 :vserv_customer_products.eff_date := v_gmt_time;
 else
 :vserv_customer_products.eff_date := sysdate;
 end if; 
 end if;
 
 if :vserv_customer_products.term_date is not null then
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:vserv_customer_products.term_date,v_gmt_time);
 Message('gmt time:TrmDBefore:Commit: '||v_gmt_time); pause; --tmppp
 :vserv_customer_products.term_date := v_gmt_time;
 else
 :vserv_customer_products.term_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 end if;
*/
 NULL_PROD_CHK; --tmppp
 ---
 commit_form;
 end if; 
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 else
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('PRE-FORM');
 :control_block.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
end;
